ABOUT THE DATA

Make your data visible.

Upload a UTF-8 CSV with one row per country and year. Files are processed in your browser and are not uploaded to a server.

Required: country, iso3, year. Include at least one of incidence, cases, mcv1, mcv2.

Optional: population, region (AFRO, AMRO, EMRO, EURO, SEARO, WPRO), income_group, development_status, gavi_eligible.

Incidence is cases per million people. MCV1 and MCV2 are coverage percentages (0–100). Leave missing values blank. ISO3 codes match countries to the map.

Regional coverage is population weighted only when all contributing coverage rows have population; otherwise an unweighted country mean is explicitly labeled. Regional incidence uses total reported cases / population only when all rows with population have reported cases (or incidence). Missing values are excluded; missing years break lines.

Income, development and Gavi labels are supplied classifications, not inferred. The built-in data and classifications are synthetic and must not be used as health evidence. Geographic boundaries are from geo-countries / Natural Earth; no endorsement is implied.
